notes: Fixed the balance from an imported bank statement when every transaction shares one date: a single-day download used to report the day's oldest balance instead of the latest one (a newest-first file ending at $900 reported $920), and that wrong number then overwrote your saved balance. The importer now works out the file's order from the running-balance math when the dates can't tell it. Also fixed the Plan tab's goal line, which used to say you were "$0.00/month short" when there was simply nothing left to save.
